Lesson 3 · A Day at the Park
Reading Adventure

A Day at the Park

Lesson 3

Join Ali and Omar for a fun day at the park! Read their adventure, learn 15 new words, and play exciting games along the way. 🌳

🎯 Learning Objectives

  • Learn 15 new vocabulary words
  • Read and understand a short story
  • Identify the main idea and important details
  • Answer reading comprehension questions
  • Identify nouns, verbs, adjectives, pronouns & prepositions
  • Arrange words to form correct sentences
  • Use new vocabulary in speaking and writing
  • Describe activities at a park
Warm Up

🗣️ Speaking Corner

Before we start, let's talk about the park! Answer in complete sentences.

  • 🌳 Where do you like to go on the weekend?
  • ⚽ What do you like to do at the park?
  • 👫 Who do you go with?
  • 🎠 What is your favourite park activity?
  • 🦆 What animals can you see at a park?

Reading · Part 1 of 5

📖 A Day at the Park

It is a beautiful Saturday morning.

Ali and Omar are going to the park with Ali’s family.

They are very excited.

When they arrive, they see a big playground with swings and slides.

Reading · Part 2 of 5

📖 A Day at the Park

Omar runs to the football field.

“Come on, Ali! Let’s play football!”

Ali smiles and runs after him.

Reading · Part 3 of 5

📖 A Day at the Park

After playing football, they sit on a bench under a big tree.

They eat sandwiches and drink some juice.

Reading · Part 4 of 5

📖 A Day at the Park

Then, they walk to a small pond.

They see some ducks swimming in the water.

Ali carefully feeds the ducks.

“What a beautiful day!” says Ali.

Reading · Part 5 of 5

📖 A Day at the Park

Before going home, the boys play on the swings.

They have a wonderful day at the park.
